cluster.headline: Saudi Arabia discovers massive uranium deposits after US nuclear deal

primary_source.title: Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman, address to the 70th IAEA General Conference, Vienna, 14 Sep 2026: ~110 million tonnes of uranium- and rare-earth-bearing ORE identified at the Jabal Sayid project, Madinah region; no ore grade and no contained-uranium estimate disclosed
